## Overview

This entry documents the integration testing activity carried out under work item AB#3651 ("Integration Testing") between 2026-03-17 and 2026-03-23. All work was performed by [Developer 1]. No pull requests were raised during this period. The effort involved building a new integration test suite, iterative bugfixing of a smoke-test script, removal of automated E2E testing in favour of documented manual steps, and final cleanup of warnings and test code.

## Activity Narrative

### 2026-03-17 — Smoke-Test Script Development and Bugfixing (Commits 1–5)

[Developer 1] initiated the integration testing work by creating a semi-automated integration/smoke-test script (`deployment/smoke-test.sh`) and an accompanying test-data file (`deployment/test-data/BE_SMOKETEST.txt`), adding 321 lines of new code. This was followed by three successive bugfix commits (`d9f59c2`, `3caa466`, `de655a3`) that iteratively refined the script, resulting in a net reduction of the script's size as logic was corrected and consolidated. A final commit on this date (`21350c8`) updated the logging behaviour within the smoke-test script.

### 2026-03-18 — E2E Removal and Integration Test Suite Creation (Commits 6–7)

[Developer 1] removed the automated E2E testing approach (`deployment/smoke-test.sh` was deleted along with `deployment/test-data/BE_SMOKETEST.txt`) and updated `README.md` with manual E2E steps (+49 lines). In the same session, [Developer 1] added a full integration test project to the solution (`LkvLogistik.sln`), contributing 1,239 insertions across 11 files. The new test project (`LKVLogistic.Cli.IntegrationTests`) included:

- **Fixtures:** `BillbeeMockFixture.cs`, `SftpGoFixture.cs`
- **Test classes:** `SftpClientTests.cs`, `SyncOrderFeedbackIntegrationTests.cs`, `SyncOrdersIntegrationTests.cs`, `SyncProductsIntegrationTests.cs`, `SyncStocksIntegrationTests.cs`
- **Test data:** `TestData/CsvTestData.cs`
- **Project file:** `LKVLogistic.Cli.IntegrationTests.csproj`
- **README.md** was also further updated (+34 lines)

### 2026-03-23 — Warning Fixes and Cleanup (Commits 8–9)

[Developer 1] resolved compiler/linter warnings in the integration test project (`BillbeeMockFixture.cs`, `SftpGoFixture.cs`, `SftpClientTests.cs`) and performed further cleanup across `SftpClientTests.cs`, `SyncOrderFeedbackIntegrationTests.cs`, `SyncOrdersIntegrationTests.cs`, and `SyncStocksIntegrationTests.cs`, resulting in a net reduction of 49 lines.
